summary: Added granular retry and reassessment actions for AI intelligence benchmarks, including single-question and final synthesis re-runs, flexible assessor selection, and resilient assessment failure handling.

changes.text: Added per-question re-run and reassessment actions in the Admin benchmark run detail view, allowing individual question replies and assessments to be regenerated without repeating the full benchmark run.
Introduced an assessor selection dialog for retries and reassessments, enabling benchmarks to use an alternative evaluation model if the original assessor is disabled or unavailable.
Added dedicated actions to re-run final synthesis assessments and retry all unscored or failed assessments across a benchmark run in bulk.
Hardened benchmark assessment failure handling so that assessor errors or unparseable evaluations are recorded per question with truncated error details rather than failing the entire benchmark run.
Updated benchmark reports and question metrics to display the specific evaluator when an individual question is scored by a different assessor than the overall run.

summary: Introduced an automated AI Intelligence Benchmark test suite in Admin, added blind assessor evaluation, provider error classification and retry mechanisms, ModelRole bitmask support for benchmark-only models, and comprehensive Markdown report export.

changes.text: Added an automated AI Intelligence Benchmark subsystem in the Admin panel featuring configurable question suites across Simple, Intermediate, and Advanced difficulty tiers.
Implemented blind LLM assessment with automated 0–10 scoring, qualitative reviews, and arithmetic versus holistic score divergence detection.
Added transient provider error classification (HTTP 429, 503, 529, timeouts) to exclude infrastructure outages from scores, with one-click re-runs for failed questions.
Expanded System AI Configurations with a ModelRole bitmask (Chat, Title, Benchmark), allowing dedicated models for benchmarking without exposing them to end-user chat.
Added exportable 7-section Markdown benchmark reports and benchmark request volume tracking in telemetry analytics.

summary: Added tracking and persistence for actual served AI service tiers across Google Gemini, OpenAI, and Anthropic providers, and fixed an issue with saving system API keys in the Admin panel.

changes.text: Added tracking and database persistence of the actual served AI service tier returned by Google Gemini, OpenAI, and Anthropic providers, including service tier reporting in session metadata, message issue reports, and debug logs for tier downgrades.
Fixed an issue in the Admin panel where system AI API keys failed to save properly.

summary: Added configurable parallel tool execution modes and pet awareness in game snapshots, optimized token efficiency and prompt caching for Anthropic and Google models, introduced an AI request governor to mitigate rate limits, added detailed token usage analytics to Admin, and improved subagent resilience, display names, and auto-saving settings.

changes.text: Added per-provider Parallel Execution Mode settings (Allowed, On request, Sequential only) in API Keys management to prevent rate-limit errors on free or low-tier keys.
Added pet awareness to game snapshots, allowing the Overseer to recognize tame companions on the current level along with their positions, stats, and equipment.
Optimized prompt segmentation and caching for Anthropic and Google models to significantly reduce input token usage, latency, and TPM consumption.
Added an AI request governor with automatic concurrency management and rate-limit cooldown handling to prevent API quota throttling.
Added detailed token usage breakdown and prompt cache efficiency metrics to the Admin analytics dashboard.
Added tool-call history digests to retain structured context about past tool executions and parallel batches across multi-turn chats.
Added a user setting to display 'Sequential' and 'On request' badges in the chat model selector and dropdowns when parallel execution is restricted for an active key.
Added human-readable subagent display names in the chat interface to show clear and informative labels when delegating tasks to subagents.
Improved subagent execution resilience with dedicated session rate limits, queue capacity limits, and clear partial result reporting when subagents terminate early.
The settings page now auto-saves when values are changed. Removed the Save button.
Fixed subagent model resolution fallback to ensure subagents only select eligible models with valid decrypted API keys.

summary: Introduced autonomous subagent delegation and execution tracking in chat, added game dump snapshot sanitization with readable ASCII dungeon maps, added the dynamic refresh_snapshot tool for live game updates, and added a subagent permission toggle in AI Settings.

changes.text: Added autonomous subagent delegation support, allowing the Overseer to delegate complex research and investigation tasks to specialized subagents.
Added real-time subagent task execution tracking in the chat interface, displaying delegated subagent progress, reasoning, and tool calls.
Added the refresh_snapshot tool, enabling the Overseer to request updated game state and inventory snapshots on demand.
Improved game dump snapshot sanitization to make ASCII dungeon maps clean and readable to the Overseer while eliminating extraneous markup.
Added a subagent permission toggle to AI Settings to control whether the Overseer may spawn subagents.

summary: Added parallel tool execution support and user-configurable parallel tool limits, introduced AI service tier selection across models and chat, improved tool output sanitization and thought isolation, and fixed model configuration editing behaviors.

changes.text: Added parallel tool execution support, allowing multiple tools to run concurrently during a single conversation turn for faster responses.
Added service tier configuration support across AI providers, enabling selection of tiers like Auto, Default, Flex, Priority, and Fast in model settings and chat.
Added a 'Max Parallel Tool Calls' option to Performance Settings to customize concurrent tool limits.
Clarified item appearance tool guides and policies to prevent randomized item identity hallucinations from pre-shuffle descriptions.
Fixed raw tool call syntax and control tokens leaking into visible chat responses by improving reasoning text sanitization and thought tag isolation.
Fixed custom thinking levels, reasoning modes, and reasoning summaries resetting or falling back incorrectly when editing AI models.
Fixed display name auto-population and reset behavior when switching between catalog and custom models in AI system configurations.

summary: Added bulk actions to move active chats to Trash and unpin conversations, introduced chat management and Trash access in Settings, and improved authentication handoff and embedded app integration.

changes.text: Added bulk actions to move active chat conversations to Trash at once, with an option to include or protect pinned chats.
Added an action to unpin all pinned chat conversations simultaneously.
Added chat management tools and Trash bin access directly to the Settings page.
Replaced the plain redirect screen with a styled loading screen during authentication handoffs.
Improved embedded application integration and navigation synchronization across mobile and desktop platforms.

summary: Added NetHack source code search and file inspection capabilities, improved client-side error handling for network disconnections, and fixed markdown table formatting issues.

changes.text: Added NetHack source code search, definition lookup, constant queries, and file viewing tools to inspect NetHack C code alongside GnollHack.
Added clear NetHack repository labels to tool execution headers in the chat view when querying NetHack source code.
Improved client-side network error handling across all views and prevented transient connection dropouts from generating false crash reports.
Added a reasoning mode badge to the Overseer's chat messages.
Fixed markdown table formatting breaking when table cells contain numeric colons or squished sentences.
Added model display names used in chat to the database.

summary: Added chat session pinning, search, and Trash bin recovery, introduced automated database retention and storage maintenance, added total response duration to AI messages, and upgraded confirmation dialogs.

changes.text: Added chat session pinning to keep important conversations anchored at the top of the sidebar.
Added search functionality to quickly find chat sessions in the sidebar and search through deleted sessions in the Trash modal.
Added a Trash bin for soft-deleted chat sessions with the ability to restore conversations or permanently empty trash.
Added an Admin database storage dashboard and automated background maintenance service for data retention, session purging, tool call pruning, and orphaned attachment cleanup.
Added total response duration timing to AI chat messages alongside Time to First Token (TTFT).
Replaced browser-native confirmation prompts with modern in-app modal dialogs across Settings, API Keys, and Admin views.
Added progress modals and toast notification feedback for administrative operations and maintenance tasks.
Fixed unauthenticated requests returning 401 Unauthorized status codes when logged out.

summary: Added local NetHack Wiki search and view tools, improved background indexing and database performance, and fixed chat layout and scrolling issues.

changes.text: Added local NetHack Wiki search and view tools to query NetHack mechanics, items, monsters, and strategies offline.
Optimized startup performance by running knowledge base, wiki, and source code indexing asynchronously in the background, and added database performance indexes for chat.
Improved chat auto-scroll behavior to maintain steady and smooth positioning during streaming AI responses.
Fixed markdown code block rendering and horizontal overflow issues for long code snippets and formatted content.
Fixed tool call headers overflowing the chat message bubble when displaying long tool arguments.
Fixed an issue with streaming not completing.
Fixed LaTeX formulas not rendering correctly.

summary: Improved GitHub tool integration and error handling, and disabled the NetHackWiki search tool.

changes.text: Improved GitHub tool integration with detailed rate limit status, reset countdowns, and clearer error messages.
Disabled the NetHackWiki search tool due to external bot access restrictions.
Prevented transient external tool network and rate limit errors from generating false crash reports.

summary: Fixed unnecessary error reporting for transient AI provider errors.

changes.text: Fixed unnecessary error reporting for transient AI provider errors and service overloads.

summary: Fixed the copy to clipboard button to copy only the main response.

changes.text: Fixed the copy to clipboard button to copy only the main response without internal thinking blocks.

summary: Added Sentry crash reporting.

changes.text: Added Sentry crash and error reporting for both frontend and backend.

summary: Improved the Gnoll Overseer avatar animation system.

changes.text: Improved the Gnoll Overseer avatar animation system.

summary: Added new animations to the Gnoll Overseer avatar.

changes.text: Added two new animations to the Gnoll Overseer avatar.
Fixed an issue with tool boxes.

summary: Fixed an issue with immediate attachment loading.

changes.text: Fixed an issue with immediate attachment loading.

summary: Added a new thinking animation and improved the knowledge base.

changes.text: Added a new thinking animation.
Improved the knowledge base integration.

summary: Improved iOS attachment handling.

changes.text: Improved attachment handling on iOS.

summary: Added support for Gemini 3.7 Flash and fixed an iOS logout issue.

changes.text: Added support for the Gemini 3.7 Flash model.
Fixed an issue that could cause a background logout on iOS.

summary: Improved styling for the Add Model popup and added time to the release notes.

changes.text: Improved the styling of the Add Model popup.
Added the release time to the release notes.

summary: Fixed an issue with the media picker on iOS.

changes.text: Fixed an issue with the media picker on iOS showing a Take Photo option that crashed GnollHack if clicked.

summary: Various UI improvements and a fix for reconnection issues.

changes.text: Fixed a reconnection problem.
Made the admin and API keys pages scrollable.
Added various styling improvements.

summary: Added support for reasoning modes and summaries. Various fixes.

changes.text: Added support for reasoning modes and reasoning summaries.
Improved the changelog feature by adding better pagination.
Fixed several UI layout issues that occurred on iOS devices.
Fixed cold start problems to improve initial loading times.
Fixed an issue with checkboxes not showing correctly on iOS.

summary: Moved changelog to settings and general fixes

changes.text: Moved the changelog link to the settings menu.
Applied various stability fixes.

summary: Fixes for chat message duplication and date parsing

changes.text: Resolved an issue where live chat messages could sometimes be duplicated or processed out of order.
Fixed a date parsing issue that caused relative times to display incorrectly for certain date formats.

summary: Fixed a missing message chunk issue

changes.text: Fixed an issue where parts of the AI's response could be missing if they arrived while the chat session was still loading.

summary: Various Improvements

changes.text: Use a better theme color for the browser bar. This color may be applied when accessing the Overseer via the web.
Improve the changelog page with better styling and groupping of similar items.

summary: Added Changelog Feature

changes.text: Gnoll Overseer's changelog is now available through a dedicated Changelog link in the main chat window's sidebar. If the changelog has an important update, a yellow star will appear next to it as well.
